ld.description: California Gold Nutrition® Sleep Time Balm "For A Little Shut Eye" Featuring Lavender Oil & Chamomile Extract USDA Organic & Certified by Oregon Tilth No Gluten or GMOs No Sulfates, Preservatives or Phthalates Cruelty-Free & No Animal Testing Key Ingredients Beeswax Shea Butter, Olive Oil & Vitamin E Lavender Oil & Chamomile Extract Bergamot, Rosehip, Rosemary & Ginger Oil Arnica, Calendula, Cucumber & Rosemary Extracts Restful sleep is an elusive thing for many people. Our busy schedules and hectic lifestyles can often lead to racing minds and anxiousness at bedtime. If you’re suffering through days feeling exhausted, only to find that sleep still evades you when you lie down at night, it’s time to find a solution. California Gold Nutrition® Sleep Time Balm Stick combines a soothing beeswax balm with relaxing aromatics to help you wind down at the end of the day. Formulated with lavender oil and chamomile extract, this balm uses calming scents and botanical oils to help put your mind and body at ease, so you can get some much needed rest.
